scope: Broaden the DXF reader/writer peer screen, inspect declared source and corpus lineage, resolve current undxf artifact-version ambiguity, and refine optional comparator readiness without expanding per-slice validation.

findings.evidence: The docs.rs package page identifies v0.3.3, published 2026-10-16, and documents ASCII/Binary DXF read claims from R12/AC1009 through 2018/AC1032 plus an ASCII writer. The repository says entity coverage is still growing. The API documentation describes a format-neutral model and planar geometry normalized to world coordinates.
findings.license: Dual MIT/Apache-2.0 according to the package and repository pages.
findings.lineage: The project describes itself as clean-room and excludes GPL-family sources, but its PROVENANCE ledger lists ACadSharp and ezdxf as DXF cross-checks and its public corpus notes include ACadSharp samples. A separate implementation is plausible; reference and test evidence is correlated. No code-level source overlap audit was performed.
findings.artifactIdentity: The package page reports 0.3.3, but the generated API page returned in this review labels itself 0.3.0. Checksum, .cargo_vcs_info source commit, matching API/source version, lockfile and feature profile are not resolved.
findings.dwgAnd3dScope: No independent DWG, AcDs, ACIS/SAB, B-rep, or native-consumer route established by this DXF package review.
findings.planUse: Use only at the existing composed DXF checkpoint if a named local gap remains. Pin exact artifact/source/dependencies, use scratch-authored inputs and an independent expected manifest, and report typed/normalized/unknown/omitted/refused dispositions. Do not add a Rust toolchain or peer run to ordinary implementation slices.

findings.evidence: The docs.rs landing page returned in this review identifies undxf 0.1.1, while the docs.rs latest ReadError API page identifies 0.8.0 and documents a Binary error with byte offset. The pinned 0.2.0 CAVEATS file remains available. The current registry artifact and matching source revision are unresolved by these conflicting page snapshots.
findings.historicalEvidenceBoundary: The 0.2.0 corpus, entity, binary-DXF and ACIS-wireframe figures apply only to that pinned version and must not be repeated as facts about an unresolved later/current artifact.
findings.planUse: Before any future run, resolve registry metadata, checksum, .cargo_vcs_info source revision and uncad lockfile dependency. If unavailable or inconsistent, record NOT_RUN and continue.

entryConditions: A named unresolved DXF gap remains after existing local generated controls.
Resolve exact crate checksum, source commit, matching API snapshot and lockfile before toolchain setup.
Use a scratch-authored control and expected manifest independent of peer output and peer-derived corpus counts.
Record DXF mode/version and per-source typed, normalized, unknown, omitted or refused disposition.
Keep the peer at the composed checkpoint; do not add it to per-slice validation.
